translationResources.title: Tabs
translationResources.description: Organizes content into panels shown one at a time. Accessible tabs with arrow-key navigation, line / enclosed / soft / pills variants, semantic colors and vertical orientation.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Overview opens first. Reviews shows the review text; Similar books remains disabled.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: The same Hot, New and Completed tabs in line, enclosed, soft and pills variants; Hot starts selected in each.

colors.title: Colors and manual activation
colors.description: color sets the group color; a Tab color keeps that tab tinted while inactive. With activationMode="manual", focus moves without selecting, so the parent can confirm the change in onChange.

vertical.title: Vertical
vertical.description: orientation="vertical" stacks the tabs; ArrowUp / ArrowDown move between them.

TabsProps.value: Value of the selected tab (controlled; pair with onChange)
TabsProps.defaultValue: Value of the initially selected tab (uncontrolled)
TabsProps.onChange: Called with the value of the newly selected tab
TabsProps.activationMode: automatic selects on focus; manual only on Enter / Space / click

TabListProps.loop: Moves focus from the last tab to the first (and back) with the arrow keys
TabListProps.ref: Ref to the tab list <div> element

TabProps.value: Value identifying the tab and its panel (no whitespace)
TabProps.disabled: Disables the tab (skipped by arrow keys)
TabProps.color: Overrides the group color; the tab stays tinted while inactive

TabPanelProps.value: Value of the tab this panel belongs to
TabPanelProps.forceMount: Keeps the panel mounted (hidden) while its tab is not selected. Without it, inactive panels are unmounted. <minerva-tab-panel> keeps regular children mounted (like forceMount) and offers this choice for <template> content with its force-mount attribute

cssVars.--tabs-gap: Space between the tabs of the list
cssVars.--tabs-trigger-padding-x: Horizontal padding of a tab (every variant)
cssVars.--tabs-trigger-padding-y: Vertical padding of a tab (every variant)
cssVars.--tabs-trigger-min-height: Minimum height of a tab (pills default to the density's control height minus 4px)
cssVars.--tabs-radius: Corner radius of enclosed / soft / pill tabs (defaults to --radius-md)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: <minerva-tab> elements go to the tab list automatically; each <minerva-tab-panel> is linked to the tab with the same value. label names the tab list; arrow keys skip disabled tabs.

variants.title: Variants and colors
variants.description: variant picks line, enclosed, soft or pills; color tints the selection, and a color on a <minerva-tab> keeps it tinted while inactive.

vertical.title: Vertical and manual activation
vertical.description: orientation="vertical" stacks the tabs (ArrowUp / ArrowDown). With activation-mode="manual", focus moves without selecting until Enter or Space; no-loop stops at the first / last tab.

controlled.title: Cancelling a change
controlled.description: minerva-change is cancelable: while the box is checked, preventDefault() keeps the current tab. Uncheck it to switch tabs.

panels.title: Inactive panels: mounted or not
panels.description: React's <TabPanel> unmounts inactive panels by default and keeps them (hidden) with forceMount. Light DOM children belong to the page, so <minerva-tab-panel> cannot unmount them: regular children behave like forceMount (hidden, state kept, form fields still submitted). Put the content in a <template> for React's default (created while active, removed afterwards), and add force-mount to keep it mounted while hidden.

props.noLoop: Stops arrow keys at the first / last tab instead of wrapping around.
props.label: Accessible name of the tab list (aria-label / aria-labelledby on the element work too).
props.tabs: The <minerva-tab> elements of this group, nested groups excluded (read-only).

events.minerva-change: The user selected a tab (detail: { value }). Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current selection.

methods.select: Selects the tab with the given value, firing minerva-change first (used by the tabs on click, Enter / Space or focus).

props.selected: Whether the tab is the selected one (set by <minerva-tabs>).

props.forceMount: Mounts the content of a <template> child even while the panel is inactive (hidden), like React's forceMount. Regular children are always mounted.
